sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: When you sign in with Kakao or Google, we store the display name, profile picture and email address the provider shares with us, plus an ID that links your account to that provider. We also store what you add to the map: toilets, confirmations and reports.

sections.heading: Your location
sections.body: When you allow location access, your position is used in your browser to center the map and is sent to our server only to look up nearby toilets. We don't store it or link it to your account.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body: Your account information is used to sign you in, to limit spam, and to let moderators review submissions. Your display name may appear to moderators next to things you added. We don't sell personal information or use it for advertising.

sections.heading: Who else is involved
sections.body: The map is provided by Kakao Maps, sign-in by Kakao and Google, and the site runs on hosting and database providers that process data on our behalf. Opening directions takes you to Kakao Map, which has its own policy.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: Account information is kept until you ask us to delete your account. Toilets you added stay on the map without your name.

sections.heading: Your choices
sections.body: You can ask for a copy of your data or have your account deleted by contacting us.
